name: Lonely Road
intro_text:
The road behind you has already disappeared into fog.
Only one thing still feels real: the abandoned car waiting beside the shoulder.
If you want answers, you will have to begin there.

roadside.name: Roadside
roadside.description: You stand alone on a silent roadside. A battered car waits under a dead streetlight, its metal body reflecting the last trace of rain.

inside_car.name: Inside The Car
inside_car.description: You are inside the car now. The cabin smells of dust, gasoline, and old leather. The dashboard is cracked, but the steering wheel and front seats are still intact.

enter_car.missing_req_message: Something is stopping you from entering the car.
enter_car.already_done_message: You are already inside the car.
